theorems.name: Submission.dpf_pb_imrep_pullback_integral_tendsto
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U K' : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n) (α : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) (ψ : ℕ → Euclid P → Euclid P) (φ : Euclid P → Euclid P) (C : ℝ), IsCompact K' → K' ⊆ U → Continuous α → HasCompactSupport α → tsupport α ⊆ U → (∀ k, ContDiff ℝ 1 (ψ k)) → (∀ k x, x ∉ K' → ψ k x = x) → (∀ k x, ‖fderiv ℝ (ψ k) x‖ ≤ C) → (∀ x, Tendsto (fun k => ψ k x) atTop (𝓝 (φ x))) → (∀ x, Tendsto (fun k => fderiv ℝ (ψ k) x) atTop (𝓝 (fderiv ℝ φ x))) → Tendsto (fun k => ∫ x in R.carrier, (R.mult x : ℝ) * R.orient x ((α (ψ k x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ (ψ k) x)) ∂μHE[n]) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x in R.carrier, (R.mult x : ℝ) * R.orient x ((α (φ x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ φ x)) ∂μHE[n]))
